source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Choose one enemy unit as the quarry at battle start. Being embarked in a **[TRANSPORT](vsdata:core-rule/embarking)** leaves this choice available to the unit. Its models get **[[PRECISION]](vsdata:weapon-ability/precision)** on attacks against the quarry and can reroll the **[Hit roll](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls)** for each such attack.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 7 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
